status: Confirmed exit-time TLS lifetime defect; removed by existing #911 ownership fix. Original bad_alloc allocation and original X11-loss trigger remain unlocated.

original.symbol_limit: Original executable absent. A nearby retained binary corroborates the three hot destructor return PCs with a common +0x40 shift; cold unwind return 0x442514 matches exactly. This is corroboration, not exact original symbolication.

sequence: libc destroys current-thread TLS, including the Unicode LruCache and its owned mutex.
The old static activeGuiRun destroys the unfinished ScenarioContext during global exit handling.
Track-move cleanup restores the track order, triggering TapeStrip label layout.
Unicode::performAnalysis reuses the destroyed TLS cache, whose initialization guard remains set.
reproduced_mechanism.observed_failure: std::system_error (Invalid argument) from the freed mutex; another retained-binary run hangs in that mutex.
reproduced_mechanism.owner_lifetime: No destroyed MainComponent or engine is assumed: exit() does not unwind the application main stack.
reproduced_mechanism.fix: #911 makes GuiRun a MainComponent member. Normal shutdown destroys it while the window/framework live; fatal X11 exit no longer runs scenario cleanups as a global exit handler.

regression_old.outcome: Exception, terminate and crash report; expected failing regression control.

regression_fixed.outcome: Prompt fatal-display exit; no exception, completion verdict or crash report.

targeted_results.test_change: The display-loss guard now interrupts gui.timeline_track_move after native audio-editor context creation, covering the actual pending track-restoration cleanup. The separate interrupted-save black-box leg is retained.
targeted_results.isolation: Private Xvfb, private null PipeWire, empty child-only ALSA configuration, private profile and copied immutable executables.
targeted_results.unsupported_binary_control: Native editor marker absent: standalone guard exits77 before starting display/audio resources.
targeted_results.main_build: cmake --build build -j6: exit0; no new warnings. No new C++ product code.

limits: Original std::bad_alloc allocation call was not captured and not newly reproduced; the proven freed-cache defect explains the historical exit-cleanup mechanism and exact cold unwind site but does not prove which freed payload produced that historical allocation exception.
Why the historical X11 display disappeared remains unproven. New loss is deliberately injected.
Three old failures and three fixed controls establish this lifetime path, not a statistical reliability guarantee.
No new sanitizer run: this is same-thread TLS/global destruction order, diagnosed directly by GDB; no suppression added.
historical_rebuild: An isolated 8162114e source build was configured but stopped after causal proof was obtained from retained binaries; it is not a built-original or validation result. Provenance and stop receipt remain under rebuild-8162114e/.
